header.cleanBody: For this Nexus, its symbols are unaffected by opposing effects, and its number of cores can't be brought to less than three by opposing effects. Also, once per turn, when the number of cores on this Nexus is reduced, if the total number of cards in your Hand and Removed Zone is less than the opponent's, you can +1 core to this Nexus. Then, you can send one core from this Nexus to your Reserve.
